code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    freq=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if max(Counter(row).values()) >= 0.7*w and Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] != bg]
    cols=[]
    for c in range(w):
        col=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if max(Counter(col).values()) >= 0.7*h and Counter(col).most_common(1)[0][0] != bg: cols.append(c)
    if len(rows)<2 or len(cols)<2: return [[bg]]
    return [[grid[rows[i]][cols[j]] for j in range(len(cols)-1)] for i in range(len(rows)-1)]
'''
